units.title: Diameter, Girth and Bark Thickness
outcomes: State the national protocol for DBH measurement (over bark, 1.37 m, trees from 10 cm)
Measure tree diameter and girth accurately with a diameter tape and calipers
Convert between girth and diameter using D = G / π
Explain the effect of bark thickness on over-bark and under-bark measurements
Identify and avoid common sources of error in diameter measurement

units.title: Measurement of Tree Height
outcomes: Define total height and distinguish the six heights measured along a tree
Estimate height without instruments by the ocular, shadow and single-pole methods
Apply the tangent method in all four standing positions, adding eye height correctly
Recognise when a tree leans enough to invalidate the tangent method, and apply the sine method
Identify sources of error and classify them as random or systematic
Assign trees to DBH and height classes using the standard width rules
